sentences.en: I cannot even boil water, much less roast a turkey.
sentences.zh: 我连水都煮不了，更别提烤火鸡了。

sentences.en: The accused spoke equivocally and didn't want to talk turkey.
sentences.zh: 被告说话含糊其辞，并不想开门见山地说实话。

sentences.en: We want Kylie Minogue to come to Turkey, especially Gaziantep.
sentences.zh: 我们希望凯莉·米洛能来土耳其，特别是加济安泰普。

senses.zh: 火鸡，火鸡肉，笨蛋，失败之作Turkey：土耳其
